max-van-leeuwen--ar-sundial.why_en: A virtual sundial lit by the real sun casts a shadow that tells the true time.
max-van-leeuwen--ar-sundial.why_zh: 一个被真实太阳照亮的虚拟日晷，投下的影子报出真实的时间。

roelof-knol--cat-fish-projection.why_en: Projected fish scatter across the floor when a cat chases them: AR for an audience that cannot read screens.
roelof-knol--cat-fish-projection.why_zh: 投在地板上的鱼群被猫一追就四散逃开：给看不懂屏幕的观众做的 AR。

samuele-albani--con-touch-2.why_en: An instrument that only makes sound when two people touch each other's shoulders.
samuele-albani--con-touch-2.why_zh: 一件乐器，只有两个人互相触碰肩膀时才会发出声音。

max-van-leeuwen--portal-gun.why_en: Shoot two portals onto real walls and look through one to see your room from the other.
max-van-leeuwen--portal-gun.why_zh: 在真实的墙上打出两个传送门，透过一个门，从另一个门的位置看自己的房间。

max-van-leeuwen--body-clones.why_en: As you move, frozen 3D copies of your body stay behind in the room.
max-van-leeuwen--body-clones.why_zh: 你一边移动，身后一边留下被定格的立体分身。

adrien-m-claire-b--just-your-shadow.why_en: A dancer negotiates with her own shadow, which refuses to simply follow.
adrien-m-claire-b--just-your-shadow.why_zh: 舞者和自己的影子讨价还价，而影子并不肯乖乖跟随。

julie-curtiss--lune.why_en: However you walk around her, the painted figure keeps turning her back to you.
julie-curtiss--lune.why_zh: 无论你怎么绕着走，画中的女人总是转过身去背对你。

roelof-knol--depth-lines-on-paper.why_en: A plain paper card becomes a hole into the table, and the hole moves when you slide the card.
roelof-knol--depth-lines-on-paper.why_zh: 一张白纸卡变成桌面上的一个洞，推动纸卡，洞也跟着移动。

field-io--extreme-measures.why_en: Measure a gap by inflating a virtual elephant until it fills the space.
field-io--extreme-measures.why_zh: 把一头虚拟大象吹胀到塞满空隙，用它来量空间有多大。

sarah-ticho--soul-paint.why_en: Paint your feelings onto a body where you feel them, then walk among everyone else's.
sarah-ticho--soul-paint.why_zh: 把情绪画在身体上你感受到它的位置，再走进其他人画出的身体之间。
